description: Ministry of Sports - Order under Sports Act, that the Elections be Convened & held to elect New Office Bearers to the Sri Lanka Judo Association and to the Hand-ball Association
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the Minister of Sports exercising powers under the Sports Act (No. 25 of 1973) to suspend the registration of national sports associations and appoint a competent authority. The core action is based on statutory authority (Sections 32 and 33 of an Act) and constitutes a regulatory/legal order, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While it names a government minister and an official, the detailed portfolio responsibilities are not the focus; the central element is the exercise of legal powers to issue regulatory orders.
